limitations: Qualification verifies fixed task answers, real tool linkage, continuation/rewind/reset, transport and finite-state checks; it is not a general model-quality evaluation.
Generated-token hashes are retained only as diagnostics; they are not correctness gates.
Finite scans cannot prove absence of all stale finite state. Production-kernel numerical/canary tests remain separate evidence.
Adapter zero-host-staging and absence of Q27_MTP_HOSTSTAGE are checked separately; expected control H2D/D2H transfers are not host collectives.
Native API context probes have no Harness UI number. UI rates are recorded only for actual UI tests.
